title: Baked Plum & Quark Pots with Cinnamon and Walnuts
description: Warm cinnamon-baked plums spooned over cool creamy quark with crunchy walnuts, creating a simple sweet-tart evening snack with strong temperature and texture contrast.

title: Beetroot, Green Lentil & Feta Wholegrain Wraps with Rocket and Dijon-Herb Yoghurt
description: Portable wholegrain wraps filled with earthy beetroot, seasoned green lentils, salty feta and peppery rocket, served with a thick Dijon-parsley yoghurt for a bright, creamy finish without making the wraps soggy.

title: Blackberry, Chia & Skyr Pots
description: Thick, creamy skyr pots layered with juicy blackberries and chia seeds, lightly sweetened with honey for a simple portable snack with fresh fruit acidity and a gently set texture.

title: Blackberry, Skyr & Jumbo Oat Overnight Pots with Chia and Toasted Walnuts
description: High-protein overnight pots combining creamy plain skyr, chewy jumbo oats and chia with a sharp-sweet crushed blackberry and lemon ripple, finished with fresh blackberries and walnuts toasted immediately before serving for aromatic crunch.

title: Cannellini Bean, Tomato & Wholewheat Pasta Salad with Basil Pesto and Rocket
description: A portable high-protein wholewheat pasta salad with creamy cannellini beans, ripe tomatoes and peppery rocket, bound with a bright basil-pesto dressing enriched with blended cottage cheese and lemon for additional protein and freshness without excessive oil.

title: Carrot & Cucumber Batons with Edamame Hummus
description: A portable afternoon snack of crisp carrot and cucumber batons with a bright, savoury edamame hummus flavoured with lemon, tahini, garlic and cumin. The hummus is blended until smooth but substantial, while the vegetables are kept dry and separate until eating to preserve crunch.

title: Clementine & Almond Snack Boxes
description: A simple portable snack of sweet whole clementines and crisp unsalted almonds, portioned for easy transport without unnecessary preparation.

title: Clementine, Pistachio & Pumpkin Seed Snack Boxes
description: A crisp, naturally sweet portable snack pairing whole clementines with unsalted pistachios and pumpkin seeds for contrasting freshness, crunch and satisfying healthy fats.

title: Clementine, Pistachio & Pumpkin Seed Snack Pots
description: Portable morning snack pots combining fresh clementine segments with lightly toasted pistachios and pumpkin seeds, finished with a restrained maple-cinnamon glaze and a small amount of salt for contrast.

title: Cocoa, Raspberry & Skyr Pots with Ground Flaxseed
description: Creamy cocoa-vanilla skyr layered with lightly crushed raspberries and ground flaxseed for a sharp-sweet, chocolatey evening snack with contrasting smooth, juicy and gently nutty textures.

title: Gochujang Tempeh, Aubergine & Mushroom Rice Bowls with Sesame Cabbage and Cucumber
description: Korean-inspired brown rice bowls with deeply browned gochujang-glazed tempeh, caramelised aubergine and mushrooms, balanced by crisp sesame cabbage and cool cucumber.

title: Harissa Tempeh, Roasted Pepper & Bulgur Salad with Lemon Yoghurt and Parsley
description: A portable high-protein lunch salad of deeply browned harissa-coated tempeh, sweet roasted red pepper and nutty bulgur, balanced with sharp lemon yoghurt, fresh parsley and restrained seasoning. Components are cooled before packing so the salad remains fresh rather than steaming itself in transit.

title: Herb-Roasted Seitan with Crispy Potatoes, Carrots, Savoy Cabbage and Mushroom-Onion Gravy
description: A high-protein vegetarian roast dinner with steamed then herb-roasted seitan, crisp golden potatoes, caramelised carrots, tender Savoy cabbage and a deeply savoury mushroom-onion gravy.

title: Kiwi, Greek Yoghurt & Hemp Seed Pots
description: Chilled evening snack pots combining thick Greek yoghurt with fresh lime and vanilla, ripe kiwi and lightly toasted hemp seeds. The kiwi provides bright acidity and juicy texture while the toasted hemp seeds add nutty aroma and gentle crunch.

title: Miso-Ginger Tofu, Broccoli & Brown Basmati Stir-Fry with Sesame and Edamame
description: A high-protein dinner of crisp-edged tofu, broccoli and edamame tossed through a glossy miso-ginger sauce and served with nutty brown basmati rice. High wok heat develops browning before the sauce is added, while rice vinegar, ginger and toasted sesame keep the finished dish savoury, aromatic and balanced rather than heavy.

title: Miso-Sesame Tofu & Edamame Soba Noodle Salad with Broccoli and Carrot
description: A portable Japanese-inspired soba salad with crisp-edged sesame tofu, edamame, tender-crisp broccoli and raw carrot, coated in a punchy miso, ginger, soy and rice-vinegar dressing.

title: Oatcakes with Hummus and Cucumber
description: A simple portable snack of crisp wholegrain oatcakes with creamy hummus and cool cucumber, packed separately so the oatcakes stay crunchy until eating.

title: Orange & Cinnamon Skyr Pots with Toasted Walnuts
description: Creamy cinnamon skyr layered with fresh orange segments and finished with warm, deeply toasted walnuts for a simple evening snack with bright citrus, aromatic spice and crisp texture.

title: Plum & Almond Skyr Pots with Cinnamon
description: Portable morning snack pots of thick plain skyr layered with lightly macerated fresh plum and finished with cinnamon-toasted almonds. Lemon and a restrained amount of honey sharpen the fruit while the toasted nuts provide crisp contrast against the cool dairy.

title: Plum, Almond & Cinnamon Yoghurt Pots
description: Creamy Greek yoghurt topped with ripe cinnamon-dressed plums and crunchy almonds, with just enough honey to round out the fruit's acidity while keeping the snack fresh, portable and simple.

title: Raspberry-Lemon Protein Pancakes with Skyr and Pistachios
description: Light, tender lemon protein pancakes made with egg whites and skyr, served with fresh raspberries, cool skyr, maple syrup and crunchy pistachios.

title: Red Lentil, Spinach & Cauliflower Dal with Brown Basmati Rice and Cucumber Raita
description: A high-protein red lentil dal with browned cauliflower, wilted spinach and a deeply aromatic cumin, ginger, garlic and tomato base, served with nutty brown basmati rice and a cool lemon-mint cucumber raita. The cauliflower is roasted separately for caramelised edges before being folded through the finished dal so it retains texture.

title: Smoked Paprika Roasted Chickpeas with Cucumber Sticks
description: A portable afternoon snack of crisp roasted chickpeas coated with smoked paprika, cumin and lemon zest, served with cool cucumber sticks for fresh contrast. The chickpeas are dried thoroughly before roasting and packed separately from the cucumber to preserve crunch.

title: Smoked Paprika Roasted Chickpeas with Satsuma Segments
description: Crisp-edged chickpeas seasoned with smoked paprika and cumin, paired with juicy satsuma segments for a portable sweet-smoky snack with contrasting texture and freshness.

title: Smoky Black Bean & Mycoprotein Fajitas with Charred Peppers, Sweetcorn, Tomato Salsa and Lime Yoghurt
description: Smoky, deeply browned mycoprotein and black beans with charred peppers and sweetcorn, served in warm wholemeal fajita wraps with a sharp fresh tomato salsa and cooling lime yoghurt.

title: Spinach, Mushroom & Cottage Cheese Egg Muffins with Seeded Wholemeal Toast
description: Savoury high-protein breakfast muffins with deeply browned mushrooms, wilted spinach, cottage cheese and seasoned egg, served with crisp seeded wholemeal toast. The vegetables are cooked dry before assembly so the muffins remain tender and structured rather than watery.

title: Spinach, Mushroom & Cottage Cheese Shakshuka with Wholemeal Toast
description: A protein-rich shakshuka with deeply browned mushrooms, spinach and a smoky cumin-tomato sauce, finished with softly set eggs, creamy cottage cheese and crisp wholemeal toast.
